actions.title: Modules removed in Python 3.12 (distutils, imp)
actions.recommendation: Replace distutils.version.LooseVersion with packaging.version.Version and imp with importlib.
test_guidance: Helpers that do not touch Spark are tested with plain pytest functions. Check the return type, boundary values and determinism.

actions.title: ANSI SQL mode enabled by default (Spark 4.0)
actions.recommendation: Use try_cast / try_to_date where dirty input is expected, or set spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false explicitly. Update tests that assert on null results for bad input.
test_guidance: Casting strings to int, double or date returns null for invalid input unless ANSI mode is enabled. Test both valid and invalid values, and pin spark.sql.ansi.enabled explicitly in the test session so behaviour does not change with the runtime.

actions.title: SQLContext is deprecated
test_guidance: Create one SparkSession per test session with a session-scoped pytest fixture. Use master local[1], disable the Spark UI and set spark.sql.shuffle.partitions to 1 so tests start fast and stay deterministic. Never connect to a real cluster from unit tests.
